integrity: Proof and reproducible exact-arithmetic source are included; numerical enumeration does not establish all-order assertions. No independent external review was performed.
scientific_limitations: Asymptotic sign theorem requires fixed distinct run lengths and positive finite limit of ones/zeros ratio. Only explicit (1,9) exact three-density witnesses are proved for all t>=10. Finite critical density signs and general nonuniform sampling are not covered. Classical exact run-count laws may imply some identities; priority is not independently established.
title: Minimal reentrant covariance for exact run lengths in fixed-weight binary words
